verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official SDK or client library for building applications against the Solo 2. It shows only a CLI (`solo2 list`, `update`, LED admin commands), firmware build and flash instructions for Hacker keys, and a probe finding that the official solo-python CLI is broken against current python-fido2. Firmware build tooling and a CLI are building blocks or adjacent tools, not official SDKs, so the axis applies but is undelivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
